final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT r.ordervault AS reference, o.orderflow AS status, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON CAST(r.ordervault AS BLOB) = CAST(o.recordvault AS BLOB) GROUP BY r.ordervault, o.orderflow), step2 AS (SELECT status, SUM(record_count) AS status_total FROM step1 GROUP BY status), step3 AS (SELECT s1.reference, s1.status, s1.record_count, 1.0 * s1.record_count / s2.status_total AS ratio FROM step1 AS s1 JOIN step2 AS s2 ON CAST(s1.status AS BLOB) = CAST(s2.status AS BLOB)), step4 AS (SELECT status, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM step3 GROUP BY status) SELECT s3.reference, s3.status, s3.record_count, s3.ratio, s3.ratio - s4.avg_ratio AS difference FROM step3 AS s3 JOIN step4 AS s4 ON CAST(s3.status AS BLOB) = CAST(s4.status AS BLOB) WHERE s3.ratio > s4.avg_ratio ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
